caption: The drawing consists of three black line drawings on a beige or light brown background, depicting different views of a side chair. The topmost drawing shows the chair from a top-down perspective with a rectangular seat, marked with the measurements 16 1/4 inches for depth and 22 1/2 inches for width. Below this, the front view of the chair displays a rectangular seat with four vertical slats forming the backrest, enclosed within a frame. To the right, a side view illustrates the profile of the chair with a straight front edge and a slightly angled backrest, showing the seat height as 17 inches and the total height to the top of the backrest as 36 3/4 inches. At the top right of the drawing, stylized text reads "SCALE DRAWING OF SIDE CHAIR." All illustrations, dimension markings, and text are created using black ink or pencil. The background overall appears to be aged paper, with some discoloration especially near the edges.
title: Side Chair (one of pair)
